articles.summary: "We’ve entered the AI age. Bold and strong leadership isn't just an advantage, it's a necessity!" - Aviran Mordo Introduction: When The Old Playbooks of Leadership No Longer AppliedWe often imagine engineering leadership as a series of decisions: what to build, how to scale, which tools to adopt. But in practice, the most defining moments happen when you don’t have the answers. When the market shifts, the world changes, or the technology rewrites its own rules.That’s the reality Yaniv Even-Haim,
articles.title: Leading Through Uncertainty: How Wix Engineering Navigates Growth, AI, and the Unknown
